translations.en: From the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)

chunks.arabic_text: مَنْ حَفِظَ أَحَادِيثَنَا أَرْبَعِينَ حَدِيثًا بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَالِمًا فَقِيهًا

translations.en: Whoever preserves forty of our narrations, Allah will raise him on the Day of Judgment as a scholar possessing understanding.

en.summary: This hadith highlights the virtue of preserving and transmitting the narrations of the Ahl al-Bayt. It promises that anyone who memorizes or safeguards forty specific traditions will be resurrected on the Day of Judgment as a knowledgeable and jurisprudently skilled scholar.
en.seo_question: What is the reward for memorizing forty hadiths according to Shia tradition?
